sloka: ततो वेगः समुद्रस्य सनक्र मकरो महान् ।स बभूव महाघोरः समारुत रवस् तदा ॥६-२१-२८॥।।
transliteration: tato vegaḥ samudrasya sanakra makaro mahān ।sa babhūva mahāghoraḥ samāruta ravas tadā ॥6-21-28॥।।

translations.english: Then the ocean seemed terrible with the fish and crocodiles rushing out with the speed of water and powerful wind.
